items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: So he made all the one-nighter's with us.

ctx.x: So we went from there up to San Francisco, and from San Francisco, we did a series in one night. Now in San Francisco, Iggy Shevack, had to come down the court. Eddie Bender was getting divorced or something, he told me the night before he was supposed to be down. He said, 'I'm supposed to be in court tomorrow.' And I said, 'Well you'd better go.' He said, 'Well what'll you do?' I said, 'I don't know.' So I'm standing in front and a fella said, 'You looking for a bass player?' I said, 'Yeah, I need one tomorrow.'…
So he sent him in, this fella made the rest of the two of them, Iggy never came back. So he made all the one-nighter's with us.
